title: Figure 29. LLV1 Breakup Percentages (line graph)
description: Line graph of Breakup Percent (%) versus Failure Time (sec), 0–280 s, for the LLV1 launch vehicle, with curves for q-alpha = 5,000, 10,000 and 20,000 deg-lb/ft². Section 6.5 text notes 290,000 simulations were made between programming time of 1 second and staging at 290 seconds, and that the drop-off from near 100% breakup occurs earlier for LLV1 due to its higher acceleration. Captioned "Figure 29. LLV1 Breakup Percentages".
